mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.slug, a.description, a.body, a.created_at, a.updated_at, t.id as tag_id, t.name as tag_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_tags at2 ON a.id = at2.article_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON at2.tag_id = t.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.user_id, a.title, a.slug, a.description, a.body, a.created_at, a.updated_at, t.id as tag_id, t.name as tag_name FROM articles a LEFT JOIN article_tags at2 ON a.id = at2.article_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON at2.tag_id = t.id WHERE a.slug = #{slug}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO articles (id, user_id, title, slug, description, body, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{article.id}, #{article.userId}, #{article.title}, #{article.slug}, #{article.description}, #{article.body}, #{article.createdAt}, #{article.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name FROM tags WHERE name = #{tagName}
